description: This file defines the Extension model class within the OpenCart admin setting module. It manages database operations related to extensions such as retrieving extension records, installing, uninstalling, and handling extension paths.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for managing extension records in the database, including CRUD operations and related data management.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extension names from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extension records filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single extension record based on its type and code.

methods.name: getTotalExtensionsByExtension
methods.description: Returns the count of extension records matching a specific extension name.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Inserts a new extension record into the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes an extension record based on type and code, and deletes related settings.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Creates a record of an extension installation, returning its ID.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Deletes a specific extension install record by ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an extension install record.

methods.name: getInstall
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension install record by ID.

methods.name: getInstallByExtensionDownloadId
methods.description: Fetches extension install data based on download ID.

methods.name: getInstallByCode
methods.description: Fetches extension install data using the extension's code.

methods.name: getInstalls
methods.description: Returns a list of extension install records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalInstalls
methods.description: Counts total extension install records matching optional filters.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Records a path related to an extension installation.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Deletes a path record associated with an extension installation.

methods.name: getPathsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Retrieves all path records for a specific extension install.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Searches for extension path records matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts path records matching a pattern.
